description: Delete your search history in the active organization. With `country`, remove that country's entries and older searches that recorded no country; older documents without a known country must finish classification before a country clear. Omit `country` to remove all history. Entries are erased, not hidden; this cannot be undone. Your history in other organizations stays. Pass the scope from `search-history.list` to reject a changed sign-in scope; these fields never select a different owner.

country.description: The jurisdiction the law pages were scoped to, as its corpus code (CZE, POL, EU).

expectedOrganizationId.description: The organizationId from search-history.list.scope. A changed active organization rejects the mutation; this never selects another owner.

expectedUserId.description: The userId from search-history.list.scope. A changed signed-in user rejects the mutation; this never selects another owner.
